purpose: Canonical build-time source contract for scale-aware World Map Places.

acquisition.note: Capture the current upstream listing/file timestamp at acquisition time; do not reuse the historical mirror seed's unknown-vintage label as canonical freshness.

promotion_rules: The downloaded input must be hashed before generation.
Upstream last-modified, retrieval time and build time are separate fields.
Generated country partitions must remain within the canonical per-partition byte budget.
Only countries selected for detailed coverage are emitted as detailed partitions.
GeoNames attribution and CC BY 4.0 licensing remain reader-visible through provenance.
The historical CC BY 3.0 mirror seed remains a bounded fallback until a reviewed canonical build is committed.
